theme_and_archetype.mood: Rooted in heritage, traditional, warm, community-focused, welcoming, contemporary

typography.instructions: Import Google Fonts via @import in index.css. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for English headings to provide an editorial heritage feel, and 'Outfit' for body text. Use native web fonts for Gujarati text if a specific font isn't loaded.

fonts.usage: Body Text, Overlines, Buttons, Nav Links

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-serif text-primary
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-serif text-primary
hierarchy.overline: uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm text-accent font-sans font-medium

typography.bilingual_rules: For bilingual headers, display the Gujarati text as a slightly smaller sub-heading or overline in a complementary color (e.g., accent or muted primary) alongside the English heading.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 for cards instead of default p-4 to ensure breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Follow 'MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID' for the campaigns section. Mix wide (col-span-8) and square (col-span-4) elements. Asymmetry is key.

components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl). Must contain the logo, English/Gujarati bilingual elements if fitting, 3 navigation links (Home, About Us, Members), and a prominent CTA for 'Contact Us' or 'Donate'.
components.hero: Asymmetric split or layered layout. Do not use generic full-width centered text unless highly stylized. Use a mix of cream background and deep red accents. Max overlay opacity for images bg-black/40 if text overlaps.
components.cards: For the Campaigns grid: Flat backgrounds (bg-white or bg-[#F5F2EB]), subtle 1px border (border-[#E5E0D8]), soft shadows only on hover (-translate-y-1 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300).
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI Input, Textarea, Button. Form should trigger an email via Resend in the backend route.
components.tables: Use Shadcn UI Table for the Members List. Keep it clean with #FAF9F6 backgrounds for headers and white for rows.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#A81A11] text-white hover:bg-[#8B150E] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors. Accent: bg-[#D68A1A] text-white hover:bg-[#C07A16].

home.hero: Hero section with NGO name, dual-language tagline (Gujarati + English), mission statement. Use a strong traditional Indian aesthetic image.
home.campaigns: Bento grid of 'Our Campaigns': blood donation, education support, religious/cultural events, mass weddings, medical camps. Use icons or photos for each.
home.cta: Section encouraging community involvement leading to the contact form.

about_us.content: History of Surat Kshtriya Yuvak Mandal, mission/vision for Khatri community, values, founding context. Use a timeline or clean typographic layout with deep red text accents.

members.content: Structured table or card grid listing committee members: President, V.President, Secretary, J.Secretary, Treasurer, IPP, and 11 M.Committee members.

logos.description: NGO Logo to be used in header and footer.

images.description: Women gathered under a decorative canopy. Use in hero section to represent community.
Festival celebration, colors. Use for religious/cultural events.
Blood donation camp. Use for blood donation campaign.
Student education. Use for education support/scholarship campaign.
Education/community representation for About Us page.

testing.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, navigation links, form inputs, submit buttons, and major sections must have a kebab-case 'data-testid' attribute representing their role. Example: data-testid='contact-submit-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not already present.
Build out the frontend strictly using Tailwind and Shadcn UI (for forms/tables) focusing on the warm red/ivory traditional aesthetic.
Configure Tailwind with the provided custom colors ('primary: #A81A11', 'accent: #D68A1A', etc) and font-families.
Create the specific routing for the 3 main pages: Home, About Us, Members.
Implement the Contact form utilizing the Shadcn components and connect the submission to a backend route for Resend emails.
Ensure the hero header seamlessly blends Gujarati and English text, treating the Gujarati as an elegant overline/subheading.
DO NOT use generic purple or teal gradients.
